Read the figure and complete the question. <image1> In the schematic diagram of the lithosphere material cycle, what number corresponds to the formation process of the rock in Figure B?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure is a schematic diagram of the lithosphere material cycle; the top is marked with “magma” and “cooling and solidification,” and there are arrows pointing to rock types, with numbers such as ① marked beside the related processes. The caption of Figure B on the right is “Hexagonal Columnar Zishan Stone Pillar Forest (volcanic rock).” Then reason: the rock in Figure B is clearly volcanic rock, belonging to magmatic rock; the formation process of magmatic rock is the cooling and solidification of magma. In the cycle diagram on the left, the process in which “magma—cooling and solidification” forms rock corresponds to number ①, so the number corresponding to the formation process of the rock in Figure B is 1.
